FX-PSPACE-001.says: The settings as they start, at frames 0, 12 and 24: nothing at frame 0 (the first particle is born 0.06 of a frame after it), then 200 a second thrown out every way from the middle as faint yellow-to-red streaks, falling a little.

FX-PSPACE-002.says: One disc, still, seen close: a round dot about 4.6 pixels across, its colour a fifth of the way from yellow to red, fully covering at the centre (Max Opacity 100).

FX-PSPACE-003.says: The same particle as a Faded Sphere: soft, fading to nothing at its edge.

FX-PSPACE-004.says: As a Shaded Sphere: lit from the upper right and in front, darker at its lower left.

FX-PSPACE-005.says: As a Bubble: a lit rim with a nearly clear middle.

FX-PSPACE-006.says: A Disc with Volume Shade 60: lit, but less than the Shaded Sphere.

FX-PSPACE-007.says: A Shaded Sphere lit from 200 degrees and low (height 10): its bright side moves to the bottom.

FX-PSPACE-008.says: Death Size 2: the disc a fifth of the way from size 10 to 2, so smaller than FX-PSPACE-002.

FX-PSPACE-009.says: A tiny disc, size 1 (under a pixel): drawn 1.4 pixels across and fainter by its true size.

FX-PSPACE-010.says: Size Variation 80 on a spread of still discs: each its own size.

FX-PSPACE-011.says: Birth and death colours blue to green.

FX-PSPACE-012.says: Origin to Death, the producer over the yellow column: the disc starts the drawing's yellow under it and goes towards red.

FX-PSPACE-013.says: Birth to Origin, over the blue column.

FX-PSPACE-014.says: Origin Constant, over the clear first column: black.

FX-PSPACE-015.says: Origin Constant over the half-covered last column: its yellow, not darkened by the half covering.

FX-PSPACE-016.says: Custom with white, yellow, orange, red and near-black: at a fifth of its life, between the first two (white and yellow).

FX-PSPACE-071.says: Custom as added, from the birth colour to the death colour: at a fifth of its life, close to FX-PSPACE-002 but not equal (the stops are spaced in 8-bit steps, the mix in linear light).

FX-PSPACE-017.says: Two overlapping discs, Composite: the nearer one over the farther.

FX-PSPACE-018.says: The two, Screen: brighter where they overlap, neither over the other.

FX-PSPACE-019.says: The two, Add: the overlap summed.

FX-PSPACE-020.says: The two with Composite With Original on: over the drawing.

FX-PSPACE-021.says: Depth Cue Fade, distance 3: the particle 2 units away fades to a third.

FX-PSPACE-022.says: Depth Cue Fog towards blue, distance 3: two thirds of the way to blue.

FX-PSPACE-023.says: A spread of still shaded spheres at many depths: nearer ones larger and over farther ones.

FX-PSPACE-024.says: A burst of discs falling: Explosive with gravity, at frames 6, 12, 24 and 40. Frame 40 drawn alone is the same as after frames 0 to 39.

FX-PSPACE-025.says: Resistance 3: the burst slows and stays tighter.

FX-PSPACE-026.says: Direction Axis, Extra Angle 30: a jet upwards within 15 degrees.

FX-PSPACE-027.says: Cone Axis, 60 degrees: a hollow cone upwards.

FX-PSPACE-029.says: Twirl: swirling round the upright axis through the producer.

FX-PSPACE-030.says: Twirly: each particle swirling by its own amount.

FX-PSPACE-031.says: Vortex: swirling and pulled in to the axis.

FX-PSPACE-032.says: Fire: rising against gravity, narrowing and flickering.

FX-PSPACE-033.says: Jet Sideways: out flat round the axis.

FX-PSPACE-034.says: Fractal Omni: Explosive in the turbulence.

FX-PSPACE-035.says: Fractal Uni: Direction Axis in the turbulence.

FX-PSPACE-037.says: Wind 1.5 to the right: the burst drifts right.

FX-PSPACE-038.says: Gravity Vector to the right: falling sideways.

FX-PSPACE-039.says: Inherit Velocity 100 with the producer keyed across: the particles carry its motion.

FX-PSPACE-040.says: Floor Bounce at 0.1, Bounciness 60, Random 30, Spread 50: the burst lands and hops.

FX-PSPACE-041.says: Floor Ice: the burst lands and slides.

FX-PSPACE-042.says: Floor Glue: the burst lands and stays.

FX-PSPACE-043.says: The effect camera turned 60 degrees about Y and 20 about X: the spread seen from the side and above.

FX-PSPACE-044.says: The effect camera 1 unit away with a 100 degree lens.

FX-PSPACE-045.says: The composition's own camera, as added: the spread drawn through it, nearer particles larger and spread wider.

FX-PSPACE-046.says: The composition camera moved 3 pixels left: the layer moves right on screen, and the particles off its plane move by more or less than it.

FX-PSPACE-047.says: The composition camera dollied in with its lens widened to match (depth -12, zoom 12): the layer's plane unchanged, the depth stronger.

FX-PSPACE-048.says: FX-PSPACE-045 with the layer moved 3 pixels right.

FX-PSPACE-049.says: The camera dollied to 2 pixels from the plane: the particles nearer than it, behind the camera, are not drawn (4 of the 17).

FX-PSPACE-050.says: Birth Rate keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 0.5 at frame 20: births start slowly and quicken.

FX-PSPACE-051.says: Velocity keyed from 0.2 to 1 over frames 0 to 20: each particle keeps the speed it was born with.

FX-PSPACE-052.says: Gravity keyed 0 to 3 over frames 0 to 24: every particle feels it when it changes.

FX-PSPACE-053.says: FX-PSPACE-024 with the layer starting at frame 10: nothing before, and frame 22 the same as FX-PSPACE-024's frame 12.

FX-PSPACE-054.says: FX-PSPACE-024 with the layer moved 3 pixels right.

FX-PSPACE-058.says: Lines, larger: the streak's length follows Birth Size.

FX-PSPACE-059.says: Birth Rate -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-060.says: Birth Rate 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-061.says: Longevity 31, above 30. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-062.says: Turbulence Scale 0, below 0.01. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-063.says: Camera FOV 171, above 170. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-064.says: Animation "spiral": not one of the eleven. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-065.says: Animation "Explosive": the word is exact. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-066.says: Particle Type "star": not one of the five (stars wait for D-612). The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-067.says: Floor Action "slide". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-068.says: Birth Color "#12345": not a colour. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-069.says: Composite With Original "yes": only "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PSPACE-070.says: Transfer Mode "multiply". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
